title: Google Play Trends in Japan Highlight New Google Pay Features
description: Google Play is trending in Japan as Google introduces new features to Google Pay, including an AI-powered financial assistant and expanded credit options.

sections.heading: Google Pay Enhancements
paragraphs: Google has announced new features for Google Pay, as reported by blog.google. The enhancements include the introduction of 'Ask Google Pay', an AI-powered financial assistant designed to help users track their spending.

sections.heading: Gemini Spark AI Agent
paragraphs: ETV Bharat reports that Google is bringing the Gemini Spark AI agent to India, which adds an AI-powered financial feature to Google Pay.

sections.heading: AI Upgrade in India
paragraphs: Hindustan Times highlights that Google Pay in India is receiving an AI upgrade with the new 'Ask Google Pay' feature, which assists users in monitoring their financial activities.

faq.q: What is the new feature introduced to Google Pay?
faq.a: According to blog.google, the new feature is 'Ask Google Pay', an AI-powered financial assistant.

faq.q: What does the AI agent do?
faq.a: As reported by ETV Bharat, the Gemini Spark AI agent adds AI-powered financial features to Google Pay.

faq.q: How does the AI upgrade help users?
faq.a: Hindustan Times states that the AI upgrade helps users track their spending.
